harrat-mujtaba:1-1.t: «هو»: the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), mubtadaʾ (subject); «الله»: a second mubtadaʾ; «أحد»: khabar (predicate) of the second; and the clause is the khabar of «هو».

harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: «الله الصمد»: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), and the clause is a second khabar of the mubtadaʾ {هُوَ}.

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: The clause «لم يلد» is a third khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: «أحد»: the noun of «يكن»; the preposition «له» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) «كفوًا».
